label: For "Core Signalling Storm Detection": Detect abnormal signalling surges in the mobile core early enough to throttle or isolate the source before it overloads authentication and session functions. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Global thresholds.
